text: Trouble in the garden. Captain, Commander Vex of the Star Navy. Pirates called the Rust Raiders are circling a peaceful garden planet. The people there grow flowers, not lasers.
A brave trader. My fleet is stuck on the far side of the galaxy. I need you to chase off three pirate ships. I'll lend you a Navy laser for the job.
Stand your ground. I've marked where each pirate ship is waiting. If they win a fight, don't worry. Mend your ship, come back and try again.
Petals in the sky. The Rust Raiders have fled! The garden planet is safe, and everyone is throwing flower petals into the sky for you.
The Navy thanks you. Please accept the Navy's thanks and this reward. The laser goes back to the Navy, but your courage stays with you.
